correctness.rationale: Directly integrate the upper dx/dt=1 flow with Q+=−2x+(x^(2k)sin(2π/x))' and the lower dx/dt=−1 parabola to obtain H_k(s)=G_k(r), H=r²−r^(2k)sin and G=r²+r^(2k)sin. The bound |D_k(x)|/(2|x|)≤2R²+πR<1 with R=2/27 gives unique sewing and a strictly increasing invariant return map H^-1 G. Its fixed points are exactly r_n=2/n, n≥27, and P−id has sign sin(2π/r). Even n≥28 are attracting, odd n repelling; basin (r_(n+1),r_(n−1)) of width 4/(n²−1). Because |dx/dt|=1 in both halves, the physical period is 8/n; P'(r_n)=(1−(−1)^n πr_n^(2k−3))/(1+(−1)^n πr_n^(2k−3)). Probability density on the radius section gives mass 54/(n²−1) and telescoping tail 27/(K−1). The Floquet magnitude n/4 atanh(π(2/n)^(2k−3)) tends to π/2 from above for k=2 and behaves as π2^(2k−5)n^−(2k−4) for k≥3; applying the exact even-grid tail proves the stated rate exponent and constant. Independently checked rational shell telescoping and even/odd multipliers for k=2,3,5 and multiple n.
